user_saw: In the Control UI sidebar, a running child session's elapsed label shifted and squeezed the title by a few pixels when the clock went from 9s to 10s.
summary: Reserves a 7ch minimum, leading-aligned slot for the sidebar elapsed-time trail so the label and title stay put when the digit count grows.
reasoning: git log -L on the .session-row-trail CSS shows it never reserved width for the elapsed text (only tabular-nums, since before the 2026-09-03 graft), so the label always moved when a digit was added; no commit broke a stable layout. This is a layout-stability polish choice (trading title width for a still clock) with no functional failure; if counted as a defect it would be never-worked from pre-graft code whose introducing commit I did not trace.
